dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: When I first told him I wanted to make sugar sculptures, Granddad gave me a sound telling off — he said, "Don't play with your food!" He said I'd get in trouble for wasting good ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: He's a stubborn old man, my granddad. It should have been obvious that all I wanted to do was show everyone how delicious our family's honey is.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Even if you're selling the same thing, people will always be drawn to the product that looks more appealing, am I right?
